A1: Hello... Hello. I urgently need to get out of the Northwest City, but the storm is blocking my way.

A3: Can anyone hear me? I just left the Northwest City and headed south, but the storm is blocking me. I'm in some abandoned camp right now.

A6: Can anyone hear me? I'm lost in the storm. There's a fallen power line to the northeast of me.
A7: Can anyone hear me? I'm lost in the storm. I see three lights to the south.
A8: Can anyone hear me? I'm lost in the storm. I see three lights to the south.
A9: Can anyone hear me? I'm lost in the storm. I saw the lights, but there's no settlement there — just radio beacons. Help me.
B1: I left the Northwest City heading east, but I got lost. I can see some cars to the southeast.
B2: Can anyone hear me? I left the Northwest City, but as soon as I got out, I lost my way. There's an abandoned convoy to the east of me.
B3: Can anyone hear me? I left the Northwest City. The journey was already long, and now I'm lost. There's an abandoned camp to the west of me.
B4: Can anyone hear me? The journey was already long, and now I'm lost. A power line has fallen to the south of me.
B5: Come in. Come in. I reached the power line. The resource gathering team is dead. Looks like they ran into raiders. Get me out of here. Over.
B6: Can anyone hear me? I barely managed to escape from the raiders at the power line. I headed south, but I don't know where to go next. Help me.
B7: Can anyone hear me? I barely managed to escape from the raiders at the power line. I headed south, but I don't know where to go next. I see something like a cave to the east. Help me.
B8: Can anyone hear me? I see three lights to the southwest. Is someone there?
B9: Can anyone hear me? I see three lights to the west. Is anyone there?
C1: Can anyone hear me? I left the convoy, but I got lost. I can see the 'Red Sun' to the east.
C2: Can anyone hear me? I'm in the middle of a military convoy.
C3: I moved south of the convoy. But visibility is zero. Help me. I can see the Red Sun to the northeast.
C4: I'm covered in snow. A power line has collapsed to the southwest. Point me in your direction.
C5: I'm covered in snow. A power line has collapsed to the west. Point me in your direction.
C6: I'm covered in snow. A power line has collapsed to the north. I can see caves to the north. Point me in your direction.
C7: Come in. Come in. I took shelter in a cave, but the firewood won't last long. Get me out of here...
C8: Come in. Come in. I left the Southern City, but I got lost. I can hear the howling of caves to the north. Get me out of here...
D1: Come in. Come in. I see a bright red light to the east.
D2: Come in. Come in. I see a bright red light to the northeast and a convoy to the west. I'm lost. Help me.
D3: I see a convoy to the northwest. I'm lost. Help me.
D4: I... I can see the outline of a lighthouse. But I can't even see what's under my feet. Light my way. I'm to the northwest of the lighthouse.
D5: I... I can see a lighthouse. I'm between the lighthouse and the power line.
D6: I... I can see a lighthouse. I'm to the southwest of the lighthouse, near a cave.
D7: Come in. Come in. I left the Southern City, but I got lost. I see a cave to the west.
D8: Come in. Come in. I left the Southern City heading west, but I got lost.
D9: Come in. Come in. I left the Southern City heading southwest, but I got lost.
E1: This is the first time I've seen the Red Sun so close. It's... It's calling to me...
E2: I left the convoy heading toward the transformer station, but I got lost along the way. I see the Red Sun to the north.
E4: To the north of the lighthouse...
E7: I left the Southern City heading north, but as soon as I got out, I immediately got lost. Help me.
E8: I live in the Southern City. I need a place to rest along the way. Light my way.
E9: I'm in the south. Outside the city, the snow is so thick that even with a searchlight you can't see more than a meter ahead.
F1: I'm lost... The Red Sun is shining to the west.
F2: I'm lost... To the west of the transformer station.
F3: Come in. Come in. The snow is blocking my view, but I can hear the sounds of the transformer station to the northeast.
F5: I'm to the east of the lighthouse.
F6: I'm to the west of the rift and to the southeast of the lighthouse.
F7: I headed northeast from the Southern City, but I immediately got lost. Help me.
F8: I headed east from the Southern City, but I immediately got lost. Help me.
F9: I left the Southern City on the southeast side, but I immediately got lost. Help me.
G1: I'm lost. I can only see the Red Sun to the west and hear noise to the south.
G2: I left the Eastern City and headed toward the Red Sun. But it never got any closer. I'm at the transformer station. Get me out of here.
G3: I left the Eastern City and went west. But I don't have enough resources to go any further. I stopped south of the transformer station. Get me out of here.
G5: I just came out of the rift on the north side and immediately got lost. Help me.
G6: I headed northeast from the Southern City, but I ended up in some kind of rift. I can get out, but I've lost my bearings. Help me.
G7: I'm on the south side of the rift.
G8: I'm to the northwest of the forest.
G9: I'm to the west of the Forest.
H1: I'm lost. The Red Sun is shining to the west.
H2: I'm lost. I just left the Eastern City. I hear some kind of buzzing to the west.
H3: I'm lost. I just left the Eastern City. I was heading west, but I got lost.
H4: I'm lost. I just left the Eastern City. I was moving southwest, but I got lost.
H5: I'm lost. I'm heading toward the rift.
H6: I... I reached the rift. There are some resources here, but I need to see light to get back.
H7: I'm on the south side of the rift. I saw lamp lights in the distance. But they don't promise anything good. Get me out of here.
H8: I came out of the forest. Looks like I came out on the north side.
H9: I stocked up on firewood in the forest. But I lost the signal with the city. Light my way to the lighthouse.
I2: I left the Eastern City heading north, but I got lost.
I3: I'm in the Eastern City, but I urgently need to leave. Guide me to the lighthouse.
I4: South side of the Eastern City...
I5: I left the Southern City. The damn storm is blocking my view. I can only see the Red Sun to the northwest.
I6: I came out of the rift and went east, but I can't go any further. Save me, I don't want to die here.
I8: I came out of the forest on the north side. I'm never going back there.
LightM: I see the light of the beacon, don’t turn it off, I’m coming.
HelpText1:
Packet Forest
The forest got its name from the locals: many plastic bags blew in from a nearby landfill and got caught in the branches of the tall trees. However, after rare Pepe frogs were discovered in the forest, it was cleaned up and declared a nature reserve, and the landfill was moved elsewhere. Part of this forest can be seen in the H9, I9 area.
HelpText2:
LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER'S INSTRUCTIONS
1. Power Supply
Stable operation of the lighthouse requires energy. Due to outdated wiring, fuses may blow.
2. Heating
To ensure comfort in cold weather, a stove has been provided to you by the management.
3. Radio
Details about travelers can be learned via the radio. The lamp on the radio displays its status.
4. Lighthouse Control
The direction of the lighthouse lamp can be adjusted manually using the control handle.
5. Navigation
To assist with orientation, an interactive map has been installed by the management.
